function hasAge(v: object): v is { age: number } {
  return 'age' in v;
}
function hasTag(v: unknown): v is { tag: string } {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && 'tag' in v;
}
function show(v: { name: string }): void {
  if (hasAge(v)) console.log(v.name, v.age);
  else console.log(v.name);
}
function showTagged(v: { id: number }): void {
  if (hasTag(v)) console.log(v.id, v.tag);
  else console.log(v.id);
}
class Animal {
  name = 'a';
}
function isFlyer(v: unknown): v is { fly(): void } {
  return typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && 'fly' in v;
}
function move(animal: Animal): void {
  if (isFlyer(animal)) {
    animal.fly();
    console.log(animal.name);
  }
}

const person = { name: 'a', age: 1 };
show(person);
show({ name: 'b' });
showTagged({ id: 3 });
showTagged(Object.assign({ id: 4 }, { tag: 't' }));
move(Object.assign(new Animal(), { fly: () => console.log('flying') }));
